outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean HMGB1 signal intensity (± SD) per compartment/genotype (N=4, n>100 cells), but only bars with error bars are shown; no individual data points are overlaid.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart of the mean % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (± SD, N=4, n>400 cells), but shows only bars with error bars without individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot image with no accompanying quantification plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot of rotarod performance over weeks with error bars; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod performance across days at each time point); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot type, which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G contains only micrograph images (Calbindin/DAPI staining) with no quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel H shows two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number, mean ± SD, N=3, n=9 per group) with only bars and error bars; individual data points are not displayed.
